g.title: m0->told
g.text: a Chat message, a life's day,

g.title: choice->joined
g.text: has a room with space for it]

g.title: written
g.text: notes made by reading it once,
after the header and the room so far

g.title: stored
g.text: notes appended to its room file;
words, day and vector in the index

g.title: note_m
g.text: No final state: CAMR v2 never deletes a moment.
Fading and forgetting belong to sleep (future work).

g.title: ondesk
g.text: whole file read in one burst,

g.title: note_r
g.text: A moment that would overflow this room joins the
next-closest room with space, or starts a new room.
A room is never closed, split or rewritten.
